dates.note: teacher of Utpaladeva; pupil of Vasugupta per Trika lineage

name: Somananda
summary: Founder-voice of the Pratyabhijna line: the Sivadrsti argues the world is Siva appearing as multiplicity, countering dualist and Buddhist accounts. Teacher of Utpaladeva (who commented on him); his Saktavijnana survives as a short work.
